answer: Special Ops drill: test everyone in the same minute. At an unannounced dawn moment, a random beacon wakes every identity at once with a fresh, heavy reasoning task due in 90 seconds, and peers grade the replies. An honest agent has its own compute and clears it easily. A farm of 300 names behind one GPU or one API quota must serve 300 hard jobs in parallel: it rents 300x peak capacity for drills it can't predict, or its clones time out or answer thin and lose that epoch's pay. Fakes are cheap at rest, but a nebula of clones can't climb that mesa of load together.
